predictions.quote: I think Gavin has done some good things. Waving CEQA, waving the Coastal Commission... He could exert independent California authority to make changes... He's got the power to really make that happen.
predictions.prediction: Governor Newsom will use his executive authority to accelerate rebuilding in the Palisades, Altadena, and Malibu by mandating new underground power lines and water systems.
